cases.title: Show response panel count tags
steps: Inspect the line-item and participant panel headers.
cases.expected: The panel headers show count tags matching the line-item response count and participant response count.
cases.setup: Use a project with known line-item response and participant response counts.
gaps: Assert the line-item response panel header displays a count tag.
Assert the participant response panel header displays a count tag.
Assert the two panel count tags match their respective line-item and participant response counts.

cases.setup: Use a project for which Clara returns an analyze_data todo and a redirect URL.
gaps: The exact control for starting the available awarding analysis is not defined in the catalog; unconfirmed label: Start Awarding Analysis
The returned redirect URL cannot be captured or compared dynamically
